fields.native_module: engine/pc_port module implementing the identity, or null

fields.delivery_receipt: citation of an actual transport/reward delivery for gate 5 (transport_reward), or null; required for admission
fields.source: list of docs/PIKMIN2_*.md filenames the evidence is transcribed from
fields.notes: free-form review notes (natural vs injected labels)
